title: Giants' John Harbaugh reportedly called Titans owner directly in attempt to trade for DT Jeffery Simmons

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants' John Harbaugh reportedly called Titans owner directly in attempt to trade for DT Jeffery Simmons
sources.description: Harbaugh, according to a report from The Athletic, took an unorthodox approach in his pursuit of the 3-time All-Pro defensive tackle, who wound up going to the Chicago Bears.
